mapper.select:
WITH settled_dau AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT alr.uid) AS value FROM account_login_record alr
WHERE alr.create_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND alr.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
), settled_pay_users AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pay.uid) AS value FROM ( SELECT cr.uid FROM charge_record cr
WHERE cr.charge_status = 2 AND cr.channel NOT IN ('REDPACKET_GET_PAY', 'PROXY_PAY') AND cr.create_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND cr.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
UNION ALL SELECT cpr.uid FROM charge_proxy_record cpr
WHERE cpr.charge_status = 2 AND cpr.create_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND cpr.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
) pay ) SELECT settled_dau.value AS settledDau, settled_pay_users.value AS settledPayUsers FROM settled_dau CROSS JOIN settled_pay_users

WITH revenue_flow AS ( SELECT DATE(cr.create_time) AS stat_date, IFNULL(SUM(cr.total_gold), 0) / 10000 AS net_revenue, 0 AS withdraw_amount FROM charge_record cr
WHERE cr.charge_status = 2 AND cr.channel != 'REDPACKET_GET_PAY' AND cr.create_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND cr.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY DATE(cr.create_time) UNION ALL SELECT DATE(bw.done_time) AS stat_date, 0 AS net_revenue, IFNULL(SUM(bw.usd_amount), 0) AS withdraw_amount FROM bill_withdraw bw
WHERE bw.status = 1 AND bw.done_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND bw.done_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY DATE(bw.done_time) ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(stat_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, IFNULL(SUM(net_revenue), 0) AS netRevenue, IFNULL(SUM(net_revenue - withdraw_amount), 0) AS grossProfit FROM revenue_flow GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date
SELECT DISTINCT country FROM `user` WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND country IS NOT NULL AND country != '' ORDER BY country
SELECT DISTINCT app FROM `user` WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND app IS NOT NULL AND app != '' ORDER BY app
